name: Register & Scope
requirements: exact registered source IDs or explicit registered_root
limitations: New project/database bootstrap remains the existing Registry responsibility
Native rescan has no narrow file filter; full registered root only

name: Prepare & Extract
requirements: existing extracted evidence or a supported exact native job
limitations: Native warning and source-validation contracts remain unchanged

name: Consolidate Equipment
requirements: exact saved equipment scope or an existing audited native import/matching plan
limitations: Read-only register reuses current stored identities; no new matching/grouping algorithm
Native import/matching retains its original eligibility and upstream checks

name: Link & Check Sources
requirements: existing links/findings or explicit comparable QC packages
limitations: Candidate links are not approved requirements
New narrowly scoped technical mapping is blocked where the native CLI cannot isolate its writes
Advanced conflict investigation is not automatic

name: Draft & Delivery
requirements: new output or verified compatible reusable package
limitations: DRAFT only; no release/approved RFQ route
Human assertions and their validity are separate from source values and release authority
